name: Active Inquiry (Feature 1)
description: Implement the active inquiry step in the mesh routing pipeline. When a worker accepts a signal (scores above threshold), it decomposes the signal into dimensions (people, projects, tickets, keywords, sentiment) and queries the worker's context knowledge base for relevant connections. Produces InquiryResult frozen Pydantic models that feed into assessment. Runs ONLY on the single accepting worker (after accept, before consensus). Uses LLM when available, falls back to embedding similarity + keyword overlap. Includes: defining InquiryResult primitive in primitives/, adding inquire() method to WorkerNode, wiring into mesh routing pipeline, and tests.

functions.name: inquire_engine
functions.description: Primary engine entry point. Decomposes an accepted signal into dimensions (people, projects, tickets, keywords, sentiment) and queries the worker's context knowledge base for relevant connections. Attempts LLM extraction first if llm_service is provided and available; falls back to embedding similarity + keyword overlap. Parallelizes per-dimension queries via asyncio.gather(). Never raises — all errors are captured in the returned EngineInquiryResult's errors field. Async.

inputs.name: signal
inputs.description: The accepted signal to decompose and query against the worker's context.

inputs.name: context
inputs.description: The accepting worker's context knowledge base.

inputs.name: llm_service
inputs.description: Optional LLM service for structured extraction. If provided and available, LLM path is attempted first.

inputs.name: embedding_service
inputs.description: Optional embedding service for similarity matching. Used in fallback heuristic path.

error_cases.name: llm_extraction_failed
error_cases.condition: LLM service was provided and available but extraction call failed (timeout, parse error, service error)

error_data.behavior: Falls back to heuristic path. Error message appended to result.errors. Does not raise.

error_cases.name: embedding_service_failed
error_cases.condition: Embedding service was provided and available but similarity computation failed

error_data.behavior: Falls back to keyword overlap only for affected dimensions. Error message appended to result.errors. Does not raise.

error_cases.name: dimension_query_failed
error_cases.condition: A single dimension query (people, projects, tickets, or keywords) raised an exception

error_data.behavior: That dimension returns empty DimensionMatch. Error appended to result.errors. Other dimensions unaffected. Does not raise.

error_cases.name: sentiment_analysis_failed
error_cases.condition: Sentiment extraction or analysis raised an exception

error_data.behavior: Returns neutral SentimentResult (polarity=0.0, magnitude=0.0, label='neutral'). Error appended to result.errors. Does not raise.

error_cases.name: total_failure
error_cases.condition: All dimension queries and sentiment analysis failed

error_data.behavior: Returns EngineInquiryResult with all empty DimensionMatches, neutral sentiment, extraction_method='heuristic', and all errors in result.errors. Does not raise.

error_cases.name: empty_signal_content
error_cases.condition: signal.content is empty or whitespace-only

error_data.behavior: Returns EngineInquiryResult with all empty DimensionMatches and neutral sentiment. Not treated as error. extraction_method='heuristic'.

preconditions: signal.id is non-empty
context.worker_id is non-empty
Signal has been accepted by the worker (scored above threshold) — this function runs only on the accepting worker
Function is called after accept phase and before consensus phase in the mesh routing pipeline
postconditions: Returns a valid EngineInquiryResult — never raises an exception
result.signal_id == signal.id
result.worker_id == context.worker_id
result.extraction_method is 'llm' if LLM path succeeded, 'heuristic' otherwise
result.timestamp is a valid ISO 8601 UTC timestamp
len(result.people.matched_terms) == len(result.people.scores)
len(result.projects.matched_terms) == len(result.projects.scores)
len(result.tickets.matched_terms) == len(result.tickets.scores)
len(result.keywords.matched_terms) == len(result.keywords.scores)
All scores in each DimensionMatch are in [0.0, 1.0]
result.sentiment.polarity is in [-1.0, 1.0]
result.sentiment.magnitude is in [0.0, 1.0]
If any dimension query failed, the corresponding DimensionMatch has empty matched_terms and the error is recorded in result.errors
If signal.content is empty, all DimensionMatch fields have empty matched_terms and sentiment is neutral
side_effects: May call LLM service (network I/O) if llm_service is provided and available
May call embedding service (network I/O or computation) if embedding_service is provided and available
Reads from context knowledge base (no mutations)

functions.name: inquire_pipeline
functions.description: WorkerNode.inquire() method in the pipeline integration layer. Decompose the given signal into dimensions (people, projects, tickets, keywords, sentiment) and query the accepting worker's context knowledge base for relevant connections. Uses LLM when available, falls back to embedding similarity + keyword overlap. All errors are handled internally — this function NEVER raises. On any failure, returns a default-constructed (empty) PipelineInquiryResult with worker_id and signal_id populated. Async.
